title: Blind whole-record computer writes race the conditional owner and dispatch updates
description:
setComputerStopped and the capability updates in conversation/src/domain/computers.ts:59,106,174,197 read the computer, rebuild it and PutItem it with no condition, while about twenty conditional UpdateItem paths in store/dynamo-messaging-store.ts:561-898 (offerOwnerDispatch, consumeOwnerBootstrap, claimHostStartGeneration, touchInteractiveWindow, queueLiveFileOperation) touch the same item. A conditional update that lands between the read and the write is silently reverted. http/host.ts:117-147 checks host_start_generation at line 118 and writes blind at line 141.

Fix: express these transitions as conditional UpdateItems through the existing updateComputerWhere helper, conditioned on host_start_generation (and owner_id where relevant); reserve putComputer for creation with attribute_not_exists(pk); collapse hostComputerStateHandler to one read and one conditional write. Add a Gherkin scenario where a dispatch lands during a stopped report and survives.
